svg.text: What lscpu exposes: 32 vCPUs on both, but a different number of physical cores
16 physical cores x 2 SMT threads = 32 vCPUs
L3 cache: 105 MiB, 1 instance shared by all cores
L2: 16 x 2 MiB 1 socket, 1 NUMA node
L3 cache: 128 MiB, 4 instances of 32 MiB
L2: 32 x 1 MiB 1 socket, 1 NUMA node
Intel: vCPU n and vCPU n+16 are two hardware threads of the SAME core (lscpu -e shows CPU 16 -> CORE 0, CPU 17 -> CORE 1, ...).
Darker = first thread of each core, lighter = its SMT sibling. AMD: every vCPU is its own core (CPU n -> CORE n).
